title: Tentative · Friday · French, gym and Terry Fox Run
arrival: This is our working plan. We may adjust it to finish learning well.
note: Tentative plan: adjust to actual learning and school notices. Resume unfinished work before advancing; use Nevermoor’s actual class bookmark, or begin the opening if needed. Teacher projector plus paper is sufficient. LST and extra device bookings are unconfirmed. Record actual outcomes separately. Terry Fox Run is 1:00–2:00 pm, replacing the long Arts block. School is closed Monday October 12; next school day is Tuesday October 13.

blocks.title: Arrival and attendance
blocks.notes: Attendance before form collection. Collect routine forms afterward; preview tentative day.
studentSteps: Answer attendance, then hand in any forms.
Look at today’s plan and get paper and a pencil ready.

blocks.title: Mathematics · show what makes sense
blocks.notes: Give a short check on taught ideas only: value of 6 in 3.064 (0.06); 0.70 vs 0.7 (=); 5.376 to hundredths (5.38); explain 5.306 < 5.36. Remove untaught items. Use the remaining time for a conference or targeted practice, and keep a brief next-step summary.
blocks.firstAction: Try the number questions on your own.
studentSteps: Try the model on paper or a whiteboard.
Explain which place or strategy supports your answer.
Complete one independent check; use it to choose our next step.
blocks.firstActionKo: 수에 관한 문제를 혼자 풀어 보세요.

blocks.title: Core French and Health Education
blocks.notes: Established specialist/prep block; follow the specialist’s programme.
blocks.firstAction: Get ready and follow your specialist teacher’s directions.
blocks.firstActionKo: 준비를 마치고 담당 선생님의 안내를 따르세요.

blocks.title: Snack and gym transition
blocks.notes: Friday snack follows recess; transition to gym by 11:10.
blocks.firstAction: Have your snack and tidy your space.

blocks.title: Physical and Health Education · gym
blocks.notes: Choose a familiar cooperative passing/target activity after checking space, equipment and access. Warm up, practise controlled movements at a suitable distance, then play a short challenge and cool down. Adjust equipment, distance or role so everyone participates. Keep the effort light ahead of the afternoon run.
blocks.firstAction: Listen to the safety directions and choose a way to join.
studentSteps: Practise a controlled pass or target movement.
Help everyone get an active turn.
Name one action that helped the group.
blocks.firstActionKo: 안전 수칙을 듣고 참여할 방법을 고르세요.

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.notes: Usual intermediate routine: outside 11:50–12:12; transition 12:12–12:13; eating 12:13–12:35.
blocks.firstAction: Follow our outside-play and lunch routine.
blocks.firstActionKo: 바깥 놀이와 점심시간에는 정해진 순서대로 하세요.

blocks.title: Quiet individual time
blocks.notes: Preserve a calm reset; a quiet non-reading choice is available.
blocks.firstAction: Choose quiet reading, drawing or an unfinished task.
blocks.firstActionKo: 조용히 책 읽기, 그림 그리기, 끝내지 못한 활동 중 하나를 고르세요.

blocks.title: Terry Fox Run · prepare
blocks.notes: Confirm route, weather, water, access and supervision with the school. Use walking, running or another school-approved participation route; do not make speed or distance a public ranking.
blocks.firstAction: Listen to the school’s route and participation directions.
blocks.firstActionKo: 학교에서 안내하는 이동 경로와 참여 방법을 들으세요.

blocks.title: Physical and Health Education · Terry Fox Run
blocks.notes: Confirmed school event, 1:00–2:00 pm. Follow the school’s route, supervision and adapted participation directions. If rescheduled, use a familiar indoor movement/art continuation.
blocks.firstAction: Join the school activity in the agreed safe way.
blocks.firstActionKo: 함께 정한 안전한 방법으로 학교 활동에 참여하세요.

blocks.title: Planners, jobs and cleanup
blocks.notes: Keep routine cleanup around 2:00; move unfinished learning forward.
blocks.firstAction: Restore our room and record any confirmed reminders.
blocks.firstActionKo: 교실을 정리하고 확정된 안내 사항을 적으세요.

blocks.title: Classroom community
blocks.notes: Use a short check-in, appreciation or familiar cooperative game. Students may speak, draw, point or pass; keep feedback specific and avoid public rankings.
blocks.firstAction: Notice one helpful action from today.
studentSteps: Offer one specific appreciation or listen.
Name a small next step for tomorrow.
blocks.firstActionKo: 오늘 도움이 된 행동 한 가지를 떠올려 보세요.

blocks.title: Pack up and dismissal
blocks.firstAction: Check your belongings and get ready for a calm departure.
blocks.firstActionKo: 자기 물건을 확인하고 차분히 하교할 준비를 하세요.

backups: Carry unfinished learning into the next suitable block rather than adding a second full lesson.
If the projector or sign-in fails, use paper, the board and available class materials.
Before dismissal: remind students there is no school Monday October 12.
